title: Moving outside-counsel work in-house.

spec.problem: Routine research, drafting and document review were billed by outside law-firm associates.
spec.changed: A 38-person internal LegalEdge team took on that work with AI-supported research, drafting and review.
spec.result: **Reduced outside-counsel reliance.** No company-wide ROI figure reported. Reuters, October 2026.

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
